title: Configuration of a game
description: Configuration of a game, in src/games/{gameName}.json (see GameConfig in src/js/config/games.ts). Also used to validate the files before publishing them (scripts/buildRemoteGames.js)

customBack.description: true: the game has its own dark background. A list of classes: only when the html tag has one of them

customPanel.description: The game has its own player panels: the dark panels of the extension are not applied

twoTeams.description: The players are in two teams

overlay.description: Add an inverted overlay of the background image (CSS variable --ext-game-back, img/background.jpg by default)

customDarkMode.description: The game manages its own dark mode with this class

customPlayerStyle.description: Selector of the elements containing a player name: they get the class ext_player_{id}, colored with the player color

playersBack.description: Selectors whose background color is the player color in dark mode, only for the colors changed by the dark mode ({{player_id}}, {{player_color}}, {{player_color_rgb}}, {{player_index_1}})

playersBorder.description: Selectors whose border color is the player color in dark mode, only for the colors changed by the dark mode ({{player_id}}, {{player_color}}, {{player_color_rgb}}, {{player_index_1}})

playersOutline.description: Selectors whose outline color is the player color in dark mode, only for the colors changed by the dark mode ({{player_id}}, {{player_color}}, {{player_color_rgb}}, {{player_index_1}})

playersTextColor.description: Selectors whose text color is the player color in dark mode, for all the players ({{player_id}}, {{player_color}}, {{player_color_rgb}}, {{player_index_1}})

customColors.description: Players colors the game can use, adapted to the dark mode even if no player has them

cssVars.description: CSS variables set on the body with an image of the game: { "--back-main": "img/background.png" }

rootCssVars.description: CSS variables set on the html tag with an image of the game: { "--ext-game-back": "img/bg.jpg" }

recommendedColor.description: Dark mode colors of the game, until the user chooses other ones

sideMenu.description: Side menu of the game (left menu with the players and board shortcuts). Missing properties take the default values (see ConfigurationWithGames)

top.description: Distance from the top of the page (CSS value), default 75px

bottom.description: Distance from the bottom of the page (CSS value), default auto

left.description: Distance from the left of the page (CSS value), default 0.5em

playerPanel.description: Id of the panel of each player with {{player_id}}, or a CSS selector of the panels (each one found with the player name)

playerPanelOffset.description: Offset when scrolling to a player panel, default 5

myPanel.description: CSS selector of the panel of the current player, when it differs from playerPanel

boardPanel.description: Id of the main board, or a CSS selector

boardPanelOffset.description: Offset when scrolling to the board, default 5

boardPanelText.description: Text of the board button, or a CSS selector starting with # of the element containing it

bottomPanel.description: Id of a panel at the bottom of the page, or a CSS selector

bottomPanelOffset.description: Offset when scrolling to the bottom panel, default 5

iconBackgroundDark.description: Background color of the icons in dark mode

iconBorderDark.description: Border color of the icons in dark mode

iconColorDark.description: Color of the icons in dark mode

iconShadowDark.description: Shadow color of the icons in dark mode

css.description: CSS added to the page when the menu is displayed (replaces the default one which makes room for the menu)
